description: This file contains functions for managing device reboot and shutdown procedures, including reading/writing shutdown reasons and status codes, performing system reboot, and handling shutdown reasons persistently via files. It is part of a device management SDK, with conditional compilation for shutdown support.

methods.name: icShutdown
methods.description: Performs device shutdown or reboot based on configuration; stores reason and interacts with watchdog or system reboot.

methods.name: delayedShutdownCallback
methods.description: Callback to execute shutdown after a delay, invoked by scheduleDelayTask.

methods.name: icDelayedShutdown
methods.description: Schedules a shutdown to occur after a specified delay in seconds.

methods.name: getShutdownReasonCode
methods.description: Reads and deletes the shutdown reason file, returning the shutdown reason enum.

methods.name: peekShutdownReasonCode
methods.description: Reads the shutdown reason file without deleting it, returning the reason enum.

methods.name: getShutdownStatusCode
methods.description: Reads and deletes the shutdown status code file, returning the code.

methods.name: peekShutdownStatusCode
methods.description: Reads the shutdown status code file without deleting it.

methods.name: getShutdownCodeForString
methods.description: Converts a string to a shutdownReason enum value.

methods.name: recordShutdownReason
methods.description: Records a shutdown reason in a separate thread, writing to files.

methods.name: recordShutdownReasonOnStartUp
methods.description: Removes existing reason files and records a new shutdown reason at startup.

methods.name: recordShutdownStatusCode
methods.description: Records a shutdown status code to files for normal and telemetry purposes.
